sentences.text: The claims tribunal has awarded Rs.3708/- by way of compensation and appellant has valued this appeal at Rs.50,000/-.
Office has also raised objection with regard to maintainability of the appeal.

3. Section 173 (2) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 reads as under :-
"(2) No appeal shall lie against any award of a Claims Tribunal if the amount in dispute in the appeal is less than one lakh Rupees"
4.
Thus, it is clear that no appeal shall lie against any award of a claims tribunal if the amount in dispute in the appeal is less than one lakh rupees.
Under these circumstances, valuation done by the appellant becomes important.

Since in the present case, total amount which has been awarded NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:8121 2 MA-2926-2025 by the claims tribunal is only Rs.3708/- and the appellant has valued his appeal at Rs.50,000/-, therefore, this Court is of the considered opinion that in view of Section 173 (2) of Motor Vehicles Act, this appeal is not maintainable.
